title: Evolución Histórica de Paris: Línea de Tiempo Isométrica sin Marco desde la Época Galo-Romana hasta el Futuro
prompt:
A frameless, edge-to-edge high-angle isometric landscape visualizing the historical evolution of Paris. The image is NOT contained in a box and shows NO vertical cross-section. The terrain surface fills the entire 16:9 frame. The composition follows a vertical zigzagging timeline, stacking eras from the ancient past at the bottom to the futuristic top along the Seine River.

The terrain transforms as it rises, showcasing the architectural history of Paris:

Layer 1 - Bottom Front - The Origin: The immediate foreground features the ancient Gallo-Roman Lutetia settlement. Massive 3D text spelling "PARIS" stands here, textured like weathered limestone blocks and ancient cobblestones. Beside it are Roman baths, arena ruins, and early Celtic settlements with thatched huts along the Seine.

Layer 2 - Front Right - Medieval Paris: The path climbs to medieval Île de la Cité. The early Gothic Notre-Dame Cathedral under construction, medieval half-timbered houses, narrow winding streets, and defensive walls surrounding the growing city.

Layer 3 - Mid-Left - Renaissance Transition: Stacked above is 16th-17th century Paris. The Louvre Palace transformation from fortress to royal residence, elegant Renaissance townhouses, formal gardens, and the Pont Neuf bridge spanning the Seine.

Layer 4 - Center Core - Enlightenment and Revolution: A dense zone featuring 18th century Paris. Grand boulevards beginning to take shape, elegant Haussmann-style buildings, the Panthéon's neoclassical dome, revolutionary monuments, and bustling market squares.

Layer 5 - Mid-Right Elevated - Belle Époque: Rising steeply with the iconic Eiffel Tower dominating the skyline, Art Nouveau Metro entrances designed by Guimard, grand department stores with iron and glass architecture, the Sacré-Cœur Basilica gleaming white on Montmartre hill.

Layer 6 - Upper Left - Modern Era: Mid-20th century Parisian modernism featuring the UNESCO building, brutalist architecture, the Pompidou Center with exposed colorful pipes, and the glass Pyramid at the Louvre.

Layer 7 - Top Peak - Future Vision: The highest point featuring futuristic sustainable Paris. The sleek towers of La Défense business district, green vertical forests covering renovated buildings, solar panel arrays, futuristic Seine river transport pods, and holographic cultural projections illuminating the sky.

Miniature figures and transport evolve as the eye moves up:
Bottom Layers: Roman soldiers, medieval merchants on horseback, horse-drawn carriages, and early wooden boats on the Seine.
Middle Layers: Belle Époque ladies with parasols, early automobiles, vintage Citroën cars, and classic Parisian bicycles.
Top Layers: Modern fashionable Parisians, tourists, electric scooters, autonomous vehicles, and flying drone taxis.

No frames, no borders, no cross-sections. Lighting transitions from warm golden afternoon light (bottom) to cool LED and neon blue-green sustainable lighting (top). The text "PARIS" is grand and monolithic.
